```plato

//==
// # Particle systems
//
// Particles, the emitters that spawn them, and the complete planar and
// spatial systems owning both together with their force fields. Positions are
// in meters, velocities in meters per second, masses in kilograms.

//==
// # Particles

// One planar particle. Velocity is in meters per second; Size is the world
// diameter in meters; Rotation is the sprite spin angle and AngularVelocity
// its rate; a particle dies when Age reaches Lifetime.
type Particle2D
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point2D;
    Velocity: Vector2D;
    Age: Duration;
    Lifetime: Duration;
    Size: Number;
    Color: Color;
    Rotation: Angle;
    AngularVelocity: AngularVelocity;
    Mass: Mass;
}
```
